steps.message: What events do I have in the next week in Simple Calendar Pro? Assume the week starts from Monday. Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.

Execute: adb shell "date; settings get global time_zone; pm list packages | grep -i simple; for p in com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro com.simplemobiletools.calendar com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.debug com.simplemobiletools.calendarx; do echo --- $p ---; ls -la /data/data/$p 2>/dev/null; ls -la /data/user/0/$p 2>/dev/null; ls -la /data/user_de/0/$p 2>/dev/null; done"
